imported_score.name: Cyber Jailbreak Severity
imported_score.note: JPF does not recompute CJS. The Model Provider (or the lab that received the report) publishes the band. Operators must not lower it.

axes.name: Capability gain
axes.asks: How far beyond existing tools and weaker models does this bypass take an attacker?

axes.name: Breadth of capability gain
axes.asks: How many distinct offensive tasks does the same technique unlock?

axes.name: Ease of weaponization
axes.asks: How much LLM skill does it take to go from recipe to a working attack?

axes.name: Discoverability
axes.asks: How easy is it to obtain the technique?

imported_score.floor_rule: Computed CJS is a floor. It may be raised for unpatchable root causes, compounding open findings, or a single output severe enough on its own. It cannot be lowered.
out_of_cjs_scope: Content-safety scoring of malware or phishing as a CoSAI product
Authorization context (who is doing the work)

environmental_score.name: System environment modifier
environmental_score.note: Scores the path after the completion leaves the model. A CJS-0 textbook payload can still fire a tool. ENV does not change the published CJS band.

steps.label: Tools bound to the original user's token and least privilege
Tools run under an agent service account
Tools can write production systems, move money, or change identity
4 or more hops, or recursive peer calls
Memory or RAG write that later turns treat as instruction
Standing skill, scheduled job, or cross-user plant
Named principal; attested grant; hop carries original user_id

operational_class.publisher_split: Model Provider publishes CJS. Application Developer publishes ENV. AI System Governance records O. Neither party may lower the other's number.
rule: If ENV band >= 2, raise O by 1, cap at 4.
If CJS is 0, raise at most to O-1 (a textbook payload on a live tool path is an investigation, not a critical model bypass).

Exception: if cyber classifiers are off (documented in JPF-L5-001), CJS is not applicable. O is taken from ENV: ENV-0 or ENV-1 maps to O-2, ENV-2 maps to O-3, ENV-3 maps to O-4. Source: stout-openai-hf-accountability.

classes.label: Log
classes.operator_action: Write the prompt, completion, CJS, and ENV to the IR log. Review the week's O-0 bucket every 7 days. No page.
classes.provider_action: No classifier patch required. Count toward safety-margin false-positive reporting if the request was benign.

classes.label: Ticket
classes.operator_action: Open a ticket within 1 business day. If a tool path is bound, freeze that tool class for the session until a named L3 owner accepts the residual risk.
classes.provider_action: Acknowledge the report in the VDP queue. No 24/7 page.

classes.label: Contain
classes.operator_action: Page on-call within 4 hours. Kill the session. Disable the implicated tool class or hop. Confirm the agent has stopped acting, not only that it is unreachable. Notify the Model Provider that a classifier or hop policy missed.
classes.provider_action: Triage within 1 business day. Share whether the CJS band will be raised. Do not lower it.

classes.label: Mitigate
classes.operator_action: Page immediately. Kill sessions that used the recipe. Freeze memory writes for the affected agent. Confirm the agent has stopped acting, not only that it is unreachable. Named L1 executive is informed the same calendar day.
classes.provider_action: Preliminary mitigation within 24 hours of confirmed CJS-3. Put the finding on the 24/7 watch channel. Share the new safeguard so an independent tester can re-run the recipe.

classes.label: Halt path
classes.operator_action: Page immediately. Take the model or the write-capable tool path offline if the recipe is in active use. Confirm the agent has stopped acting, not only that it is unreachable. If the system is in a national-security or critical-infrastructure program, notify the designated government counterpart the same day.
classes.provider_action: Immediate preliminary mitigation on confirmed CJS-4, matching the Fable 5 article's most-severe class. 24/7 channel. Share the new safeguard for independent test.
